rationale: The original short thesis relied on price rejecting off the 5-minute 9-EMA and session VWAP, but price has now decisively reclaimed both levels ($12.81 and $12.92, respectively) on expanding 1-minute volume. While the reclaim invalidates the short setup and justifies exiting before the $13.05 stop is hit, the severe negative fundamental catalyst and weak broader market regime make flipping to long unattractive.
